The '''shirtless raider'''<ref name="audio description">{{FOTV|1|1}} audio description</ref> is a character {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
===Post-War===
The shirtless wastelander was one of [[Lee Moldaver|Moldaver]]'s [[Vault 32 raider|raiders]], during their invasion and occupation of [[Vault 32]]. 

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The End (episode)|The End]]===
During the [[Vault 32 raider]]s' attack, the shirtless raider is seen aiming his [[Folding stock submachine gun|Folding stock SMG]] until a [[Vault 33 dweller]] grapples him from behind. The shirtless raider then incapacitates and kills the Vault 33 dweller by jamming and firing his gun in the dweller's mouth. Right after this, two more Vault 33 dwellers who were trying to deliver more food are shot and killed by the shirtless raider; [[Woody Thomas]], who was in the hallway, survives, however.
